Module com.lmax.solana4j
Package com.lmax.solana4j.api

Interface MessageBuilderV1

  • public interface MessageBuilderV1
    Interface for building V1 messages for the blockchain.

    V1 messages raise the size limit to 4,096 bytes, move resource limits into the message itself via a transaction config, and do not support address lookup tables. The wire format is defined by SIMD-0385.

      • priorityFee

        MessageBuilderV1 priorityFee​(long lamports)
        Sets the priority fee for the V1 message.

        Unlike legacy and V0 where the priority fee is set via SetComputeUnitPrice as micro-lamports per compute unit, in V1 it is an absolute total in lamports.

        Parameters:
        lamports - the total priority fee in lamports
        Returns:
        this MessageBuilderV1 instance for method chaining

      • computeUnitLimit

        MessageBuilderV1 computeUnitLimit​(int units)
        Sets the compute unit limit for the V1 message.

        Unlike legacy and V0 where the compute unit limit defaults to 200,000 per instruction (capped at 1.4M), in V1 it must be set explicitly or the transaction will fail.

        Note that while the wire format makes this field optional (an unset bit means a requested compute unit limit of zero, i.e. a transaction that cannot execute), this library enforces its presence at seal() time with an IllegalStateException to prevent building transactions that request no compute units. Non-positive limits are likewise rejected by computeUnitLimit itself.

        Parameters:
        units - the compute unit limit
        Returns:
        this MessageBuilderV1 instance for method chaining

      • loadedAccountsDataSizeLimit

        MessageBuilderV1 loadedAccountsDataSizeLimit​(int bytes)
        Sets the loaded accounts data size limit for the V1 message.

        Unlike legacy and V0 where the default is 64 MiB, in V1 it must be set explicitly or the transaction will fail with MaxLoadedAccountsDataSizeExceeded.

        Note that while the wire format makes this field optional (an unset bit means a requested limit of zero, which the network treats as reserving 32 KiB for the cost model), this library enforces its presence at seal() time with an IllegalStateException. An explicit value of zero is permitted and expresses that minimal budget.

        Parameters:
        bytes - the loaded accounts data size limit in bytes
        Returns:
        this MessageBuilderV1 instance for method chaining

      • requestedHeapSize

        MessageBuilderV1 requestedHeapSize​(int bytes)
        Sets the requested heap size for the V1 message.

        The heap size must be a multiple of 1 KiB in the inclusive range [32 KiB, 256 KiB], as required by the V1 transaction format; values outside of these bounds are rejected with an IllegalStateException by this library rather than by the network.

        Parameters:
        bytes - the requested heap size in bytes
        Returns:
        this MessageBuilderV1 instance for method chaining

      • seal

        SealedMessageBuilder seal()
                   throws java.nio.BufferOverflowException
        Seals the V1 message and returns a sealed message builder.

        This method finalizes the construction of a V1 message, ensuring that all required data is properly written into the buffer. It then returns a SealedMessageBuilder instance representing the sealed message.

        Returns:
        a SealedMessageBuilder instance representing the sealed message
        Throws:
        java.nio.BufferOverflowException - if there is insufficient space in the buffer to write the complete message data. This can occur if the buffer size is smaller than required to hold all the data necessary for the message.
